name: CodeYam Editor
postCreateCommand: sh .devcontainer/codeyam-system-deps.sh && npm install -g @codeyam-editor/codeyam-editor@latest @anthropic-ai/claude-code && npx -y playwright install --with-deps chromium
postStartCommand: sh .devcontainer/codeyam-system-deps.sh && mkdir -p .codeyam/logs && setsid -f nohup codeyam-editor start --hosted --no-open --port 14199 > .codeyam/logs/codespaces-editor.log 2>&1 < /dev/null
